intro: JP College of Engineering is in Tenkasi and Shiv Nadar University is in Noida. This page compares their recorded B.Tech fees, placements, admission routes and campuses for 2026.

JP College of Engineering vs Shiv Nadar University is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: JP College of Engineering vs Shiv Nadar University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose JP College of Engineering if its B.Tech programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose Shiv Nadar University if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.
JP College of Engineering lists Bachelor of Engineering. Shiv Nadar University lists B.Tech Chemical Engineering, B.Tech Civil Engineering, B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹80,000 a year as total fees for JP College of Engineering's Bachelor of Engineering. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹2.35 lakh a year as tuition fees for Shiv Nadar University's B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, JP College of Engineering's 2023 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹6 lakh for Bachelor of Engineering. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, Shiv Nadar University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹24 lakh for B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: JP College of Engineering's recorded admission tests on this page include JEE Main.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Shiv Nadar University on this B.Tech page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: JP College of Engineering is recorded in Tenkasi, Tamil Nadu, not in Noida. Shiv Nadar University is in Delhi NCR (Noida / Greater Noida). This is not a same-city choice.
If the two campuses are in different cities, factor in travel, hostel costs and where you want to live, not only the classroom.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in JP College of Engineering vs Shiv Nadar University for B.Tech. Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
If one side is missing a quotable fee or a recent official placement year, do not fill the gap with a guess from another course or an older batch.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
